Switched transparent proxying of `/api/interpreter` to POST when a GET comes in with `data`/`q` query params, mirroring the working curl pattern: the query string is moved into an `application/x-www-form-urlencoded` body and the upstream request method is set to POST while preserving logging/headers and avoiding duplicate `content-length` handling. Other endpoints/methods remain unchanged.
